about: Contract of one checker run. The chain reader writes 'readings'; the judgement adds 'verdicts' and 'overall'. Live mode writes data/latest.json (one run). Replay mode writes data/replay/<name>.json (a list of runs). The dashboard reads only these files.

rules.timestamp: The checked moment, unix seconds UTC. Live: the wall clock of the run (same as run_at). Replay: the requested time. The judgement measures every age against this value and never reads a clock itself.
rules.run_at: Wall clock of the run, unix seconds UTC. The dashboard shows 'monitor not running' when run_at of latest.json is too old.
rules.status: ok | failed. A failed reading has null values and an error text. RPC URLs are redacted from every error.
rules.block: The last block at or before 'timestamp' on that chain. Never a later block.
rules.price: String, integer with 18 decimals. Strings, because JavaScript cannot hold these numbers exactly.
rules.check: spoke_price_age | spoke_chronicle_divergence | cross_chain_price_mismatch | share_supply_mismatch (ids in checker/constants.py)
rules.result: ok | no_verdict | alert. A check whose reading failed is no_verdict, never ok.
rules.overall: The worst result of all verdicts. Order: ok < no_verdict < alert.

verdicts.reason: spoke read failed: timeout after 3 tries
